paper_title: Searching for vector dark matter with an optomechanical accelerometer
notes: Projection (not measured) for vector B-L dark photon dark matter using a Si3N4 membrane-Be mirror optomechanical accelerometer. The paper's main exclusion plot (Fig. 2) shows gB-L vs mDM for the 1-year projected sensitivity of centimeter-scale membranes covering ~2-25 kHz (mDM ~ 10^-11 to 10^-10 eV). The data points are approximate reads from the figure since no numerical table is given; values near g~10^-23 to 10^-22 are stated in text. The paper also presents a B-coupled (pure baryon) projection in Fig. 4. Eot-Wash bound quoted as g<~10^-22 for omega<2pi*10kHz.
